description: Replace redstone with node graphs. NeoForge 1.21.1 · Create & Sable · in-world editor.

mods.name: Nodewire
mods.description: Node-based logic system for Minecraft. Integrates with Create, Sable, and Create Aeronautics.

mods.name: Nodewire Scripting
mods.description: Optional addon that carries the Kotlin compiler so Nodewire's Script Node can compile in-world scripts.

releases.notes:
## Dependencies

### Runtime

| Dependency        | Version           | Required? |
| ----------------- | ----------------- | --------- |
| Minecraft         | `1.21.1`      | yes       |
| NeoForge          | `21.1.230` | yes       |
| Kotlin for Forge  | `5.5.0`     | yes       |

### Mod integrations (optional, enable extra nodes / features)

| Mod                  | Version       |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| Sable Companion      | `1.6.0` |
| Sable                | `2.0.3+mc1.21.1`  |
| Create Aeronautics   | `1.3.0+mc1.21.1`   |
| Create               | `6.0.10-280` |
| Ponder               | `1.0.82+mc1.21.1` |
| Flywheel             | `1.0.6` |
| Registrate           | `MC1.21-1.3.0+67` |
| JEI                  | `19.27.0.343`    |
| EMI                  | `1.1.24+1.21.1`    |
| Tweaked Controllers  | `(not bundled)` |

### Bundled (shaded into the jar)

| Library            | Version       |
| ------------------ | ------------- |
| Compose runtime    | `1.7.0` |
| Kotlin coroutines  | `1.8.0` |
| Yoga (AE2 fork, j17 bytecode) | `1.0.0` |
| MixinExtras        | `0.4.1` |

### Build toolchain

| Tool             | Version    |
| ---------------- | ---------- |
| Kotlin           | `?` |
| ModDevGradle     | `?` |
| Java toolchain   | `21`     |


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nitkanikita21/nodewire/compare/dev-v0.8.0...dev-v0.8.1
